title: Sudoku Grid Check
commonMistakes: Returning false when the grid contains blanks instead of ignoring blanks
Checking only rows and columns and forgetting the nine 3x3 boxes
Computing a box index from the wrong row or column grouping
Requiring the grid to be complete or solvable
followUps: How would you check whether the grid has a unique completion?
How can bitmasks replace the row, column, and box sets?
How would you validate a 16x16 grid with hexadecimal digits?
attribution: Original problem by the Base Case contributors.
